'''Drone vessel 171''' was a [[drone freighter]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
[[File:Drone_vessel_171_stormtroopers.jpg|thumb|left|250px|[[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Traneel]] and his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] come out of hiding aboard drone vessel 171]]
In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], drone vessel 171 was part of a [[Convoy/Legends|convoy]] of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[drone freighter]]s en route to the [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] with a cargo of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] components. When [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]] learned of this convoy, the Alliance mounted a daring [[Mission to steal hyperdrive components|mission]] to steal the hyperdrive components and captured the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]].<ref name="Drone Alone" />
